Definition: from G746 and a derivative of G2413; high-priestly:--of the high-priest.
BiblicalUsage: The word means of the high priest, of his kindred and household, and it appears once, when Peter and John stand before Annas the high priest and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest.
TheologicalSignificance: The high priest's whole household stood against the apostles, and the apostles stood anyway.
